title: rungia parviflora subsp. pectinata
intro: Rungia parviflora subsp. pectinata, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of Rungia parviflora. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rungia parviflora subsp. pectinata include its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help to relieve symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-hemorrhoidal properties.
